summary: Catalyst Bancorp, Inc. (Nasdaq: CLST), a Louisiana-chartered bank holding company, announced on April 7, 2026 the execution of a merger agreement to acquire Lakeside Bancshares, Inc. Under the terms, Catalyst Bancorp will pay $19.58 per share in cash for all outstanding Lakeside Bancshares common stock, representing approximately $41.1 million in aggregate consideration. The transaction consists of a share exchange followed by mergers where Catalyst Bancorp and Catalyst Bank continue as surviving entities. The deal has been unanimously approved by both boards of directors. Completion is subject to Lakeside shareholder approval, regulatory approvals, and customary closing conditions. The transaction is expected to close in Q3 2026.
